caption: The drawing depicts two identical dolls standing side by side, positioned slightly apart and facing each other. Both dolls have long, straight blond hair and wear black bonnets on their heads. They are dressed in detailed, ruffled, light purple dresses adorned with darker purple sashes, with white lace trim at the sleeves and hem. Large blue bows are tied at the back of each dress, trailing down behind them. Both dolls wear blue stockings and blue shoes. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects present besides the dolls. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the name “Edith Bremer.”
title: Doll of Bisque
